ai_diagnosis.root_cause: PC-B has no default gateway configured.
evidence: PC-B can ping other PCs on the same VLAN 20 segment but cannot ping anything outside the subnet, including the router interface.
ai_diagnosis.reasoning_summary: The 'ipconfig /all' output from PC-B explicitly shows a blank 'Default Gateway' field. A host requires a default gateway to route traffic to any network outside its local subnet. This directly explains why PC-B can communicate within its VLAN but cannot reach the router interface (10.10.20.1) or any external network, despite the router's subinterface being active and correctly configured.
fix_steps: Configure the default gateway on PC-B to 10.10.20.1.
verification_steps: From PC-B, ping a device on a different subnet (e.g., 10.10.10.1).

rule_findings.evidence: Default Gateway field is blank in ipconfig output

ai_diagnosis.root_cause: The DHCP server (R1) is configured to provide an incorrect DNS server IP address (10.10.10.99) to clients in VLAN 10, instead of the intended DNS server at 10.10.10.53.
evidence: PC-C's ipconfig /all output shows DNS Servers: 10.10.10.99
R1's DHCP pool VLAN10 configuration includes dns-server 10.10.10.99
The topology note states the intended internal DNS server is Server1 at 10.10.10.53
PC-C can successfully ping 8.8.8.8, indicating general network connectivity is functional
ai_diagnosis.reasoning_summary: PC-C is unable to resolve hostnames but has external IP connectivity. This points to a DNS issue. PC-C is configured via DHCP to use 10.10.10.99 as its DNS server. The DHCP server (R1) is configured to hand out 10.10.10.99. However, the topology note specifies that the intended DNS server is 10.10.10.53. The mismatch between the configured DNS server in DHCP and the intended DNS server is the root cause of the name resolution failure.
fix_steps: Navigate to the DHCP pool configuration for VLAN10: 'ip dhcp pool VLAN10'
Remove the incorrect DNS server entry: 'no dns-server 10.10.10.99'
Add the correct DNS server entry: 'dns-server 10.10.10.53'
Exit configuration mode and save the changes.
verification_steps: On PC-C, renew the DHCP lease: 'ipconfig /release' followed by 'ipconfig /renew'
Attempt to ping the internal hostname: 'ping www.internal-app.local'
Attempt to browse to the internal website: 'www.internal-app.local'
